title: AI Interview Coach & Audio/Voice CBT Simulator 10/10 Overhaul (Google M3 / Cuba Executive Token Harmonization & STAR Behavioral Matrix)
spec:
### Objective
Elevate the AI Interview Coach module (`src/components/Dashboard/DashboardInterviews/DashboardInterviews.jsx` and `LiveInterviewSession.jsx`) into an industry-leading interview preparation engine with Google M3 / Cuba Executive token harmonization, dynamic audio waveforms, and a comprehensive STAR behavioral evaluation matrix.

### Architectural Scope & Deliverables
1. **Google M3 / Cuba Executive Design Harmonization**:
   - Tokenize `DashboardInterviews.jsx` and `LiveInterviewSession.jsx` using Cuba Executive design tokens (`cuba-tokens.css`).
   - Elevated glassmorphic surfaces, frosted backdrop filters, crisp typography, and unified M3 button primitives.
   - Ensure dark/light theme fidelity with seamless adaptation to the universal header and navigation rail.

2. **Audio/Voice CBT Simulator & Animated Waveforms**:
   - Provide responsive, accessible audio/visual feedback during live practice sessions.
   - Animated voice activity waveforms with real-time state transitions: Idle ➔ Listening/Recording ➔ AI Thinking/Processing ➔ Audio Playback.
   - Robust media device handling via `useInterviewMedia.js` with graceful fallback when microphone access is denied or simulated.

3. **STAR Method Feedback Matrix & Competency Scoring**:
   - Instant evaluation decomposing candidate answers into the 4 STAR pillars: Situation, Task, Action, and Result.
   - Granular 0–100 behavioral scoring across core competencies (Clarity, Technical Depth, Leadership, Impact).
   - Actionable recommendations with high-impact coach suggestions and exemplar answers.

4. **Dynamic Contextual Question Banks**:
   - Ground question generation in candidate's actual resume history (years of experience, technical skills, previous roles) and target job specifications.
   - Calibrate difficulty according to seniority level (Entry, Mid, Senior, Lead, Executive) via `backend/services/aiRuntime.js` and `roleInterviewGenerator.js`.

5. **Rigorous End-to-End Verification**:
   - Author Playwright test suite `tests/e2e/dir013-interview-coach.spec.js` and config `playwright.dir013.config.js`.
   - Multi-stage verification: Stack health, Cuba theme compliance, media session lifecycle, STAR scoring validation, WCAG AA contrast (>= 4.5:1), and frozen template diff = 0.
   - Zero console errors, zero unhandled rejections, and clean build under 4.0s.
invariants: INV-1: 51 CV Templates Byte-Identical Freeze: src/cv-templates/cv1 through cv51, DOCX export, and ATS scoring must produce git diff = 0 against baseline e314f715.
INV-2: Zero-Token-Leakage & Secure Session: Never expose API keys, Bearer tokens, or raw secrets in client DOM or console logs. All AI endpoints must require valid Firebase Auth Bearer tokens.
INV-3: WCAG 2.1 AA Accessibility: All interactive controls, wave visualizers, question pills, and score cards must achieve >= 4.5:1 contrast and visible focus rings.
INV-4: Authentic MariaDB Grounding: Dynamic questions and session persistence must ground directly in real user data without fake or hardcoded mock fallbacks in authenticated sessions.
INV-5: Sub-100ms UI Latency: Micro-interactions, recording toggles, and view switches must render smoothly within 100ms budgets without simulated artificial delays.
acceptanceCriteria: AC-1: Tokenize DashboardInterviews.jsx and LiveInterviewSession.jsx with Cuba design tokens (--cuba-*, glassmorphic surfaces, M3 badge styles).
AC-2: Live Audio/Voice Simulator UI with interactive audio waveform visualization and resilient media recording state handling.
AC-3: STAR behavioral feedback matrix rendering Situation, Task, Action, Result analysis with 0-100 competency scoring.
AC-4: Contextual interview question generation calibrated by seniority level and grounded in candidate resume experience.
AC-5: Author playwright.dir013.config.js and tests/e2e/dir013-interview-coach.spec.js with 100% green pass on live stack (ports 3000 & 8080).
AC-6: Zero console, page, or API errors across all interview routes and sub-states.
AC-7: Production build passes cleanly with Vite in < 4.0s and 0 ESLint errors.

RECON FINDINGS: (1) FREEZE CONFLICT - .agents/AGENTS.md L43/L46/L50 certify backend/services/aiRuntime.js FROZEN (AI orchestration+summary+recommendation-dedup) and L48 certifies DashboardInterviews.jsx AiGenerationProcessingModal FROZEN, yet DIR-013 scope names both aiRuntime.js and DashboardInterviews.jsx as edit targets. SCOPE MUST BE NARROWED - I will not edit frozen regions; plan confines AI work to interviewCalibration.js (seniority calibration already present) and roleInterviewGenerator.js. (2) STAR + competency scoring ALREADY IMPLEMENTED backend-side: liveInterviewSession.js has normalizeCompetencies() + cited-evidence gating (omits unsupportable competencies) and STAR-narrative enforcement; interviewCalibration.js has the 5-band seniority ladder (Entry/Mid/Senior/Lead/Executive) with mayAssume/ceiling/probe guards incl. team-leadership-above-band and org-scale-exec guards. So DIR-013 deliverable 4 is largely DONE - I will verify it against live data, not rebuild it. (3) WAVEFORM EXISTS but is NOT TOKENIZED: LiveAudioWaveform.jsx has 0 var(--cuba-*) and 2 raw hex (#818cf8/#4f46e5) + rgba() strokes; DashboardInterviews.jsx and LiveInterviewSession.jsx have 0 cubaVars and 2 rawHex. This is the real AC-1 gap. (4) useInterviewMedia.js already degrades gracefully (NotAllowed/NotFound/NotReadable/unavailable -> text mode). (5) Existing live-interview UI coverage in tests/live-interview-ui.test.mjs (stubbed API); new playwright.dir013.config.js + tests/e2e/dir013-interview-coach.spec.js do not yet exist. PLAN: Step 1 tokenize LiveAudioWaveform.jsx to read --cuba-* tokens via getComputedStyle (canvas cannot use CSS vars directly) + resolve the 2 raw hex offenders in LiveInterviewSession.jsx; Step 2 verify 4-state waveform machine Idle/Listening/AI-Thinking/Playback against live session states; Step 3 verify STAR matrix + 0-100 competency scores render grounded in real MariaDB session rows (no fabricated data); Step 4 author playwright.dir013.config.js + tests/e2e/dir013-interview-coach.spec.js as a live-stack suite (mirror the proven DIR-012 config: no webServer, trace off, workers 1) covering route render, contrast>=4.5:1, focus rings, zero console/page/API errors, frozen diff=0; Step 5 full gate re-run (test:product, build <4s, ESLint, frozen diff) + submit evidence. ESCALATION: requesting Lead confirmation on the aiRuntime.js + DashboardInterviews.jsx freeze overlap before any edit.
